name: Harpy

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The harpy makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.description: The harpy sings a magical melody. Each Humanoid and Beast within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. While Charmed, a target has the Incapacitated condition and moves toward the harpy by the safest route, ignoring difficult terrain. A Charmed creature can repeat the save whenever it takes damage or when another creature takes an action to shake it out of its stupor.

description: Harpies perch on sea cliffs and crags, luring sailors and travelers with an enchanting song before descending to claw apart the entranced and pick over the wreckage.
